objective: Compare rank16 checkpointed QLoRA stability at freeze_layers=24 and freeze_layers=12 on 500 real training rows.
observations: Both rank16 freeze tests completed the 500-row calibration with changed adapter hashes and positive train/val loss evidence.
freeze_layers=12 used about 12.3 GiB VRAM during the clean run and produced 33.3 MB LoRA files.
freeze_layers=24 used about 11.7 GiB VRAM during the clean run and produced 22.2 MB LoRA files.
llama-finetune reports save-every 50 as 50 windows, so checkpoints appeared as ckpt50..ckpt550 rather than every 50 ubatch progress lines.
External .claude-deep slice/smoke finetune processes spawned during freeze12 and were killed to protect VRAM.
gpu_after: RTX 5060 Ti, about 336 MiB VRAM used, about 2% utilization
recommendation: Use freeze_layers=12 for the next quality evaluation; use save_every=50 for any long 10k rerun so manual stops leave usable LoRA checkpoints.
